articles.title: Cardano joins Solana, XRP Ledger in race to power AI agent payments
articles.snippet: The official x402 kit now includes Cardano tools for apps and AI agents to pay with ADA and other network tokens, though the facilitator has so far only been tested on pre-production.

articles.title: Why this investment bank expects little demand for tokenized stocks despite SEC’s new trading rules
articles.snippet: TD Securities expects limited demand for tokenized stocks despite new SEC rules opening a path for trading outside traditional markets.

articles.title: Crypto political group plans to spend $30 million against Sherrod Brown's Senate bid
articles.snippet: It's the biggest spending from the industry's campaign arm in 2026, much like Fairshake's $40 million against Brown two years ago was its largest-ever outlay.

articles.title: Grayscale Is Making Its Red-Hot Zcash ETF More Affordable
articles.snippet: The Zcash ETF is splitting its shares three ways after pulling in more than $233 million in under a month, as Wall Street piles into crypto's hottest privacy trade.
